result_summary.title: Analytics API returning malformed JSON in Staging
result_summary.description: Our integration team is reporting that the Analytics Dashboard is returning malformed JSON responses when fetching report data in the EU-Central staging environment. The issue started after our last deployment around 08:00. Approximately 651 test users are unable to load their dashboards because the frontend crashes when attempting to parse the response. The status code is 200, but the body is missing closing brackets or contains unescaped characters. This is blocking our release candidate testing.
